name: Assembly Line
description: This progressive assembly enables swifter production of all manner of industrial goods.

name: Engineers' Guild
description: Being able to share acquired knowledge among your peers can only lead to better results all round.

name: Imperial University
description: This colonial campus maintains the high standards taught within the Imperial Colleges of Magic back home.

effect.name: Hero recruit rank: %+n for Empire Captains

name: Continuous Production
description: Interchangeable parts and constant work shifts ensure production targets are met or even exceeded.

name: Guildmaster Professors
description: The greatest minds of the Old World are gathered by the Empire’s various institutions to impart their knowledge and methods of efficiency.

name: Combustion Agent
description: "An eighth of an ounce of this, a pinch of that, and half a pound of the other and… Boom! We have ignition!"

effect.name: Missile Explosion Radius: %+n% for Artillery units

name: Imperial Architects
description: The Imperial Architects are an eccentric bunch who have always had, well, let's say 'fanciful' ideas about how a building should look…

name: Intelligence Sharing
description: Intelligence shared is intelligence doubled.

effect.name: Hero recruit rank: %+n for Witch Hunters

name: Improved Piston Technology
description: A more efficient way of transferring force from gas under pressure speeds up the production process, meaning more steam-powered weapons ready for the fight.

effect.name: Charge bonus: %+n for Steam Tank, Luminark and Land Ship units
Unit mass: %+n% for Steam Tank, Luminark and Land Ship units
Speed: %+n% for Steam Tank, Luminark and Land Ship units

name: Improved Cavalry Armour
description: Thicker plates for riders and scaled barding for their mounts, meaning a greater percentage survive to charge again.

name: Blinkers
description: What a mount cannot see will not spook them, ensuring every charge hits the target squarely.

name: Endurance Training
description: Riding for days whilst bearing full kit increases one's stamina for the real thing.

effect.name: Vigour loss reduction: %+n% for Cavalry units

name: The Inner Circle
description: The Knights of the Inner Circle are the elite of the elite, amongst the best fighting men of the Empire.

effect.name: Attribute: Immune to Psychology for Cavalry units

name: Ambassador to the Phoenix King
description: Successful dealings with the lofty, aloof Asur takes a certain type of individual if awkward diplomatic misunderstandings are to be avoided.

name: Ambassador to the Karaz Ankor
description: Diplomatic and discreet, this one knows exactly how to deal with fiery Dwarfen temperaments, so is well placed to run the Imperial embassy to the Everlasting Realm.

name: Ambassador to the Royarch of Bretonnia
description: Deferent and respectful, the embassy to Bretonnia understands perfectly the customs and traditions of this ancient feudal society.

source.name: Ambassador to the Royarch of Bretonnia
Ambassador to the Royarch of Bretonnia
Ambassador to the Royarch of Bretonnia

name: Commodity Trading
description: There's always a new market to be tapped, or a fresh approach to existing ones.

name: Clergy of Sigmar
description: One god, one way, many agents to guarantee compliance in defence of the faith.

effect.name: Hero recruit rank: %+n for Warrior Priests

name: Grain Silos
description: It's comforting for people to know where their next meal will come from when winter's chill descends.

name: Colonial Factors
description: This joint-stock enterprise, if the trade winds prevail, is bound to make both factors and shareholders filthy, stinking rich. Amen.

effect.name: Income from Iron, Gem and Gold Mines: %+n%

name: Supply Wagons
description: An army can only march as far as its supplies will last. Wagons loaded with goods allow for larger forces.

name: Manorialism
description: Lords rule and live well, peasants work themselves to death and must pay for the privilege – it's the perfect model for any truly forward-looking society.

effect.name: [HIDDEN - do not translate] Used to increase lord rank when replacing a lord (target the effect at forces factionwide) - use in conjunction with a shown effect that targets provinces factionwide

name: Emperor of the Empire
description: Emperor Karl Franz is widely regarded as the greatest statesman the Empire has ever known, if not the entire Old World.

name: The Conclave of Light
description: When dark times arrive, Karl Franz assembles prominent leaders and statesmen from across the Old World and beyond to vanquish whichever evil now stirs to threaten the natural order.

effect.name: Diplomatic Talks can now be held between all Empire, High Elves, Kislev, Bretonnia, Dwarf and Cathay factions

name: State Troop Standards
description: As regiments gain renown, their standards become talismans that are just as important as their sword-arms.

name: State-Issued Infantry Armour
description: State Troops are often issued with armour plate to ensure unit cohesion and a reasonable level of protection.

name: State-Issued Weapons
description: Although the cost falls to each individual soldier, it is expected that all will use standardised equipment.

effect.name: Melee attack: %+n for Melee Infantry units
Melee defence: %+n for Melee Infantry units

name: Improved Heavy Weapons
description: Refined ore techniques create stronger steel, making for more durable blades and heavier weapon-heads.

effect.name: Attribute: Expert Charge Defence for Halberdier units
Charge bonus: %+n for Melee Infantry units
Weapon strength: %+n% for Melee Infantry units

name: Firing Drills
description: Packing a wallop when they strike, artillery crews are also measured on their firing rates; the faster the better.

effect.name: Reload time reduction: %+n% for Artillery units

name: Reinforced Armour Plating
description: Even the largest hulking war machine can be made more resilient to attack.

effect.name: Missile resistance: %n% for Steam Tank and Land Ship units
Attribute: Ballistic Plating for Steam Tank units
Armour: %+n for Steam Tank and Land Ship units

name: Ordnance Canisters
description: When the enemy might be an enormous monster taller than the highest spire, it's a good idea not to run out of ammo!

name: Mass-Produced Small Ammunition
description: Industrialised production of ammunition for handguns has allowed the Empire to hoard large supplies.

name: Mounted Weaponry
description: Fixing arms atop mounts and rides does away with the need to dismount and set up prior to firing, in turn reducing vulnerability and increasing efficiency.

effect.name: Missile strength: %+n% for Pistoliers and Outriders units

name: Rifled Barrels
description: The discovery of barrel-rifling led to increases in speed and accuracy. Both Dwarfs and men claim credit for this invention.

effect.name: Reload time reduction: %+n% for Missile units

name: Purge of the Foul
description: Foul Greenskins, flea-infested Skaven, gluttonous Ogres and slimy Lizardmen are abroad in sufficient numbers that an organised cull is now necessary.

effect.name: Melee defence: %+n when fighting against Greenskins, Skaven, Ogres and Lizardmen
Leadership: %+n when fighting against Greenskins, Skaven, Ogres and Lizardmen

name: Purge of the Fell
description: There may be fell Necromancy afoot, for the Undead and Unliving infest Imperial territory in too greater numbers, hastening the need for an immediate purge.

effect.name: Melee attack: %+n when fighting against Vampire Counts, Vampire Coast and Tomb Kings
Leadership: %+n when fighting against Vampire Counts, Vampire Coast and Tomb Kings

name: Purge of the Knife-Ears
description: These lands belong to the Empire – those arrogant, knife-eared Elves must be driven back to their own dominion, and with haste!

effect.name: Missile resistance: %n% when fighting against Elves

name: Purge of the Ruinous Breeds
description: The taint of Chaos has been observed here; such things must not be allowed to gain a foothold and be removed without delay!

effect.name: Weapon strength: %+n% for all units when fighting against Norsca, Warriors of Chaos, Chaos Dwarfs, Daemons of Chaos and Beastmen
Leadership: %+n when fighting against Norsca, Warriors of Chaos, Chaos Dwarfs, Daemons of Chaos and Beastmen

name: Hunters' Guild
description: Such groups are formed so that knowledge and experience can be shared for the betterment of all their members.

effect.name: Recruit rank: %+n for all Imperial Supplies units

name: Colonial Fort
description: A vital foothold in new territory and a home-from-home for Imperial subjects abroad on colonial business.

name: Seaborne Logistics
description: Fledgling colonists must be supplied from back home in the Old World until the Empire's mark is firmly made upon its new lands.

name: Imperial Reinforcements
description: If you've got a problem and no one else can help… call the Empire's best to settle the issue once and for all!

effect.name: Receive an additional detachment of reinforcements with every Imperial Supplies delivery

name: Trained Marksmen
description: Gunnery units, archers and crossbowmen are well trained in their crafts, learning not only to hit their marks, but how to avoid becoming targets themselves.

effect.name: Missile strength: %+n% for Missile Infantry units
Missile resistance: %n% for Missile Infantry units

name: Refined Schematics
description: By fundamentally redesigning how field guns are constructed, we can maximise the firepower of each machine while saving resources in less important areas.

name: Ambassador to the Tzarina
description: A minor member of the Imperial aristocracy he may be, but the Emperor's ambassador knows exactly what to say, and how to say it, to guarantee a favourable outcome to proceedings.

effect.name: Diplomatic relations: %+n with all Kislev factions

name: Ambassador to the Dragon Emperor
description: Grand Cathay is home to many wonders, many of which could be put to good use by the Empire.

name: Ambassador to the Overtyrant
description: Unintelligent though they are, one cannot deny the usefulness and power of having a mighty Ogre Tyrant on side.

name: Advisor to Nuln
description: Any who hold the ear of Countess Emmanuelle von Liebwitz enjoy boundless influence across all of Nuln.

name: The Amethyst Armourer
description: By infusing Death Magic into the powerful arms of Nuln, new, ever-more deadly weapons are conceived.

effect.name: Purchase cost: %+n% for Amethyst Artillery charges

name: Seeker of Knowledge
description: Elspeth often spends time travelling between her Towers, in search of lost lore and artefacts of untold power.

effect.name: Gardens of Morr fast travel cost: %+n%

name: Scion of the Empire
description: Despite her reclusive nature, Elspeth is and forever will be a true child and defender of the Empire.

effect.name: Gain vision of all non-hostile Empire faction's capitals

name: College Archives
description: When not training in his magic or practising his Alchemy, Gelt can often be found in the College Archives studying his crafts.

name: Cataclysmic Power
description: Under the protection of and guidance of the Colleges of Magic, Wizards can hone their craft to the highest level.

effect.name: Ability number of uses: %+n for Cataclysm Spells

name: Greater Channelling
description: The Priests atop the Luminark hone their chants and prayers, offering greater protection to those around them.

effect.name: Passive ability: "Aura of Protection Upgraded" for Luminark units

name: Pinnacle of the Empire
description: The height of Imperial Engineering; just having these machines on the battlefield rallies nearby troops to sweeping pride!

effect.name: Attribute: Encourage for Steam Tank, Luminark and Land Ship units
Local Recruitment duration: %+n turn for Steam Tank, Luminark and Land Ship units (minimum 1)

name: Teachings of Teclis
description: The Warden of the White Tower is known to many as the most powerful Wizard the mortal world has ever seen; fortunately, he imparts his wisdom gladly.

effect.name: Construction time: %+n% for Battle Wizard recruitment buildings

name: The Eight Orders
description: Long ago, Teclis founded the eight Colleges of Magic; ever since, human Wizards have gathered to learn and practise their craft.

effect.name: Winds of Magic power reserve: %+n per turn
Hero recruit rank: %+n for Battle Wizards

name: Protection of the Patriarch
description: The Supreme Patriarch protects and guides the Colleges, ensuring dangerous magics are kept tightly under control.

name: Hall of Duels
description: It is in the Hall of Duels that a new Patriarch is decided and each Wizard must prove their worth.

effect.name: Winds of Magic power reserve capacity: %+n

name: Swords of the Empire
description: Always the first into battle on the charge, these elite troops aim for the very heart of the foe.

effect.name: [[col:green]]Unlocks recruitment of the following Elector Count State Troops:\\nSwords of Ulric (Swordsmen) \\nCarroburg Greatswords (Greatswords)[[/col]]

name: Spears of the Empire
description: Braced for the onslaught, these extensively-drilled spearmen hold fast in the face of the enemy.

effect.name: [[col:green]]Unlocks recruitment of the following Elector Count State Troops:\\nEldred's Guard (Spearmen – Shields)\\nNordland Mariners (Halberdiers)[[/col]]

name: Marksman of the Empire
description: Those who dare approach Imperial battle lines must face multiple hails of arrows before the first blow is even struck.

effect.name: [[col:green]]Unlocks recruitment of the following Elector Count State Troops:\\nStir River Patrol (Crossbowmen)\\nGunderman's Surefires (Handgunners)[[/col]]

name: Machines of the Empire
description: These men's superior engineering skills are matched only by their martial prowess, as evidenced by the explosions that ring around the battlefield during the combat.

effect.name: [[col:green]]Unlocks recruitment of the following Elector Count State Troops:\\nSootson's Guns (Mortars)\\nThe Emperor's Wrath (Steam Tank)[[/col]]

name: Riders of the Empire
description: These advanced horsemen ensure that the enemy's numbers are fewer than intended when battle is finally joined.

effect.name: [[col:green]]Unlocks recruitment of the following Elector Count State Troops:\\nThe Noble Sons Abroad (Pistoliers)\\nThe Bordermen (Outriders – Grenade Launchers)[[/col]]

name: Knights of the Empire
description: Those who try to escape the fray will find their flanks blocked by noble steel, ranged against the foe in the Emperor's name.

effect.name: [[col:green]]Unlocks recruitment of the following Elector Count State Troops:\\nKnights of Morr (Empire Knights)\\nKnights of the Everlasting Light (Empire Knights)\\nThe Stubborn Bulls (Empire Knights – Greatswords)[[/col]]

name: Divine Mandate
description: As more and more accursed books are sealed, bigger and bigger temples are built, and Sigmar’s blessings smile upon us.

effect.name: Effect range: %+n% for "Grand Hammer of Sigmar"
Effect range: %+n% for "Grand Shield of Faith"

name: Fanatic's Decree
description: “The damned will fear us as we push forwards with unbridled wrath – AND THEY WILL BE DESTROYED!”
